content.text: {"answers": [{"question_id": "Q1", "question": "What system or method does the organizer use to check room availability and submit the reservation request?", "answer": "The organizer uses a calendar system and room reservation system to check availability and submit requests."}, {"question_id": "Q2", "question": "Is any approval or confirmation required from a facilities team or administrator before the reservation is considered confirmed?", "answer": "Not specified in the workflow."}, {"question_id": "Q3", "question": "What happens when the requested room or time slot is already booked — does the organizer manually search for alternatives, or does the system suggest them?", "answer": "The organizer manually selects an alternative room; no automatic suggestion is specified."}, {"question_id": "Q4", "question": "How is the confirmed room information communicated to participants, and is that notification step currently manual or system-generated?", "answer": "The organizer manually notifies participants via email or collaboration tool after updating the calendar invitation."}, {"question_id": "Q5", "question": "How are cancellations or changes to an existing reservation initiated and communicated to both the system and the participants?", "answer": "Not specified in the workflow."}, {"question_id": "Q6", "question": "Are there any required actions after the meeting concludes, such as formally releasing the room or logging whether the room was actually used?", "answer": "Not specified in the workflow."}]}
